inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage under a pale green fog sky, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art like a classic 16 bit era game battle screen, not an illustration. Bleached bone white and ash grey limestone ruins, cold slate shadows, green lichen and grass. A pale far ridge with a small stepped pyramid court in the green fog behind the ruins. The ruined crypt doorway in the middle with two small burning torches, rubble stairs on the left, a wall gripped by mossy roots on the right, two grave markers at the back of the courtyard. The courtyard where the fighters stand is a calm patch of large worn slate slabs on packed earth, a few slabs missing, a little moss creeping in from the edges, the bottom edge of the screen in soft darker shade. One single continuous 2.5D battle scene, no figures, no text.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand-pixelled 2D game background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair-stepped contours everywhere. Muted limited palette, flat colour clusters, two or three discrete shades per stone. Organic uneven shapes with carefully chipped corners. Broad quiet surfaces with occasional short angular cracks. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. The controlled pixel craft of an old burial court: irregular broad paving stones, shallow angular shadows, weathering only on selected edges. No paint brushwork, no gritty texture layer, no dithering, no gradients.", "aesthetics": "a game battle screen with a clear stage, readable 2.5D, bleached bone and green fog, chunky readable shapes, flat colour areas, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Cool overcast light from the upper left as discrete flat pixel colour planes, soft cast shadows from the ruins across the back of the courtyard, two small warm torch lights at the doorway, the bottom of the screen in darker foreground shade.", "color_palette": ["#1e2426", "#323c3e", "#505e5c", "#7a8a84", "#b4c0b6", "#e2e8dc", "#7a9a48", "#b8d080", "#e8a050"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A pale green fog sky over two pale far ridges, the nearer one carrying a small stepped pyramid court, all low contrast and hazy.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 300, 380, 660], "desc": "the ruined limestone crypt doorway with heavy pillars, a broken lintel, two worn steps and a small burning torch on each side, dark inside"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [40, 0, 360, 310], "desc": "rubble terraces and broken stone stairs with grass"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 640, 400, 1000], "desc": "an old limestone wall gripped by huge twisting mossy tree roots"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [380, 60, 880, 940], "desc": "large worn slate slabs on packed earth where the fighters stand, calm and even, a few slabs missing"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [880, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "packed earth and a little moss in soft darker shade along the bottom edge"}]}}
